behaviors_covered.control.delay_phase_budget: Complete non-default output map; zero added delay, exact budget boundary, initial=target, initial 180/target 0, negative margin/headroom, inverse frequency scaling to tiny time budgets, coupled target rejection, scalar/nonfinite invalid-then-valid recovery, finite lag despite intermediate overflow.
behaviors_covered.control.loop_sensitivity: Complete complex 3-4-5 denominator oracle; conjugation invariance; distinct complex S/T magnitudes; zero loop; positive-real loop; independent zero disturbance/noise; near-singular amplification with tiny sources; overflow-safe hypot; exact singularity and amplitude/nonfinite errors with recovery.
behaviors_covered.control.lead_crossover_synthesis: Complete alpha=1/4 design; reconstruct complex C at crossover to prove magnitude normalization and phase; geometric corner identity; independent frequency and plant-gain scaling; near-zero and near-90-degree half-angle oracles; open phase endpoints and positive magnitude/frequency guards; nonfinite recovery.
behaviors_covered.control.pi_pole_placement: Complete coefficient-matched non-default design; gain scaling, critical repeated-pole and overdamped cases, target polynomial reconstruction, one-ulp positive-Kp boundary, equality/below-boundary errors, all scalar/nonfinite recovery, representable extreme coefficient regression.
behaviors_covered.control.peak_current_slope_compensation: Complete comparator event-time oracle; unstable/marginal/deadbeat/positive contraction; zero ramp below and at half duty; volt-second identity; signed/zero/tiny perturbations; independent period scaling; all scalar/nonfinite recovery; common-slope overflow and representable tiny-duty regressions.
behaviors_covered.control.integral_two_lag_stability: Complete non-default cubic/Routh oracle; stable/marginal/unstable signed reserve; marginal imaginary mode; plant/sensor exchange; equal poles and fast-sensor limit; adjacent-f64 signed reserve; extreme time-product avoidance; reciprocal-sum overflow; positive-domain/nonfinite recovery.

verification: Not executed: no build, test, lint, formatter, backend/process or native launch. Authored against source snapshot 4c46fa1 and existing common helper. Python arithmetic used only to transcribe independent parent-scenario oracles, never to run production code.
untested_gaps: Main must run cargo test --test control and integrated suite after cherry-pick. Five source-inferred numerical defects are intentionally represented by success expectations and unignored regression tests.
Main must execute flat parent_json_lines_scenarios in order on one real process, including error/recovery adjacency. No process pass is claimed.
Native diagrams, keyboard entry, error presentation, quantity legends, clipping, narrow window and large text remain Main/V2ControlRun acceptance work. No pixel approval is claimed by tester.

No hardware calibration, nonlinear/sampled outer-loop stability, saturation or exhaustive binary64-space validation. Primary-source retrieval is inherited from research; independent algebra is newly authored.

suspected_defects.evidence: Source-inferred against snapshot 4c46fa1; not executed. 360*frequency overflows before multiplication by a reciprocal-scale delay. One full period must still give 360 degrees.
suspected_defects.minimal_correction: Scale or reorder phase rotation to avoid overflowing an intermediate when final lag is representable.

suspected_defects.evidence: Source-inferred against snapshot 4c46fa1; not executed. 2*zeta*wn overflows in both constraint line 405 and proportional-gain expression, although wn*tau=1 and all outputs are finite.
suspected_defects.minimal_correction: Use a consistently scaled coefficient product in both domain constraint and proportional-gain expression.

suspected_defects.evidence: Source-inferred against snapshot 4c46fa1; not executed. rising_slope+ramp_slope overflows; common scaling cannot change a .25 contraction into zero or an error.
suspected_defects.minimal_correction: Normalize the three slopes by their maximum before forming multiplier numerator and denominator.

suspected_defects.evidence: Source-inferred against snapshot 4c46fa1; not executed. rising_slope/falling_slope overflows although duty and signed multiplier remain representable subnormal numbers.
suspected_defects.minimal_correction: Use a scaled positive-slope sum for duty, preserving tiny finite falling/rising ratios.

suspected_defects.evidence: Source-inferred against snapshot 4c46fa1; not executed. Sum of two 1e308 reciprocals overflows before division by gain 4, although equal-pole critical gain is 2/(K*tau)=5e307.
suspected_defects.minimal_correction: Evaluate gain-scaled reciprocal terms without overflowing the unscaled reciprocal sum.

parent_json_lines_scenarios.name: delay_phase_budget_independent_nondefault
parent_json_lines_scenarios.rationale: One 125-Hz period is 8 ms. A 0.4-ms delay consumes 18 degrees; 54 degrees allows 1.2 ms.

parent_json_lines_scenarios.name: loop_sensitivity_independent_nondefault
parent_json_lines_scenarios.rationale: L=2-j4 yields S=(3+j4)/25 and T=(22-j4)/25. Apply separate 25-mV disturbance and 3-mV measurement noise.

parent_json_lines_scenarios.name: lead_crossover_synthesis_independent_nondefault
parent_json_lines_scenarios.rationale: Choose alpha=1/4: sin(phi)=3/5. C(jwc)=3.2+j2.4 has magnitude 4 and phase atan(3/4), giving unity loop gain for M=.25.

parent_json_lines_scenarios.name: pi_pole_placement_independent_nondefault
parent_json_lines_scenarios.rationale: Target denominator .125s^2+2.5s+32 requires Kp=.375 and Ki=8 for K=4; zero at -64/3 rad/s.

parent_json_lines_scenarios.name: peak_current_slope_compensation_independent_nondefault
parent_json_lines_scenarios.rationale: Comparator event moves +100 ns for -6 mV, changing next perturbation by +8 mV to +2 mV. Volt-second balance gives duty .75.

parent_json_lines_scenarios.name: integral_two_lag_stability_independent_nondefault
parent_json_lines_scenarios.rationale: Cubic .0016s^3+.1s^2+s+25 has Routh column third entry .6. At Ki=12.5 it factors as (.0016s^2+1)(s+62.5).

parent_json_lines_scenarios.name: sensitivity_near_singular
parent_json_lines_scenarios.rationale: S=-j1000. Tiny excitation remains nonzero; amplification is not an input error.

parent_json_lines_scenarios.name: pi_one_ulp_positive_gain
parent_json_lines_scenarios.rationale: 2*zeta-1 is exactly 2^-52. Strict positive-PI boundary admits this design.

parent_json_lines_scenarios.name: peak_marginal
parent_json_lines_scenarios.rationale: Threshold ramp gives alternating nondecaying perturbations, not positive stability reserve.

parent_json_lines_scenarios.name: peak_unstable
parent_json_lines_scenarios.rationale: Without ramp, m2/m1=3 amplifies alternating perturbations; do not reject the design.

parent_json_lines_scenarios.name: peak_deadbeat
parent_json_lines_scenarios.rationale: Ramp equals falling sensed slope, cancelling the next-cycle perturbation exactly.

parent_json_lines_scenarios.name: routh_marginal

parent_json_lines_scenarios.name: routh_unstable
parent_json_lines_scenarios.rationale: Routh first column has two sign changes. Negative reserve is a valid diagnostic.

parent_json_lines_scenarios.name: lead_near_ninety
parent_json_lines_scenarios.rationale: Independent half-angle identity sqrt(alpha)=tan((90-phi)/2) avoids 1-sin(phi) cancellation. 1e-7 relative allowance covers angle-reduction conditioning.
